source_title: Virginia DMV — Size, Weight and Equipment Requirements (Form DMV109) + 24VAC20-82 (Overweight/Overdimension Permits)

superload_thresholds.note: Superload = movement exceeding any of 18' wide, 16' high, 200' long, or 250,000 lbs (24VAC20-82-60). Requires a detailed travel plan and VDOT structural-engineering analysis; submit at least 10 working days before movement. Cost of the engineering analysis may be added to the permit fee.

width.note: 2 escorts (1 front, 1 rear) over 12' up to 14' wide (VA DMV Escort Guidelines table, DMV109)
3 escorts (2 front, 1 rear) over 14' up to 16' wide
4 escorts (2 front, 2 rear) over 16' up to 18' wide
over 18' wide escorted case-by-case; law-enforcement escort may be required (24VAC20-82)

height.note: 1 front escort with height pole over 14'5" high, all routes

length.note: 1 rear escort over 90' up to 150' long
2 escorts (1 front, 1 rear) over 150' up to 200' long
over 200' long escorted case-by-case; law-enforcement escort may be required

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip permit $20 flat; add $0.30 per mile if overweight or if the configuration cannot be licensed in Virginia (mobile/manufactured homes pay a flat $1.00 in lieu of the per-mile fee). Superload single-trip $30 + $0.30/mile if overweight. Overweight cost = $20 (or $30 superload) + $0.30 x miles traveled (24VAC20-82-50/-60).
single_trip.note: Fee amounts from the official DMV109 fee tables. Statutory framework in Va. Code Title 46.2 Ch. 10 Art. 18; §46.2-1139 sets a $10 multi-trip transfer fee, not the single-trip dollar amount.

annual.note: Blanket/annual: $100 for 1 year, $200 for 2 years; if overweight add $40/yr mileage fee + $360/yr damage fee. Superload multi-trip $220 for 3 months. 5% Overload annual permit $250 (raises gross to 84,000 lbs non-interstate, §46.2-1128).

movement_restrictions: Normal travel sunrise to sunset (24VAC20-82); actual movement window is printed on each permit.
No travel within the corporate limits of cities/towns during 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m. (rush-hour curfew).
Between sunset and sunrise, flagged loads must display a red light visible 500 ft (DMV109).
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; semitrailer 53' on designated system (48' otherwise). Axle limits: single 20,000 / tandem 34,000 lbs, 650 lbs per inch of tire width; gross by axle-spacing bridge table (Va. Code §46.2-1126).

In Virginia hauling permits are administered by DMV (not VDOT); VDOT performs superload structural analysis. Escort drivers must be certified (Escort Vehicle Driver's Manual HP405). All values sourced from official DMV109 / 24VAC20-82 / Va. Code fetched 2026-07-16. State-level rules only.
Overweight penalties graduated per-pound (§46.2-1134) plus civil/processing fees; doubled 25-50% over legal, tripled >50%.
